content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Bathinda District Court Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://bathinda.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Bathinda District Court Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Bathinda District Court to fill various technical and operational positions across different departments under the judicial district of Bathinda in Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in Bathinda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for various posts including Lift Operators, Generator Operator, and Technician (Electrical) under this specific employment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts available in this recruitment drive include Lift Operators (6 posts), Generator Operator (1 post), and Technician (Electrical) (1 post) on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form to the designated address is 15-10-2026 before 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for Bathinda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode. Candidates need to send their filled application form along with required documents via post or by hand to the office address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or pay scale for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary and remuneration for these contractual posts are based on the rates fixed by the Deputy Commissioner, Bathinda from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: Applications on the prescribed proforma along with attested copies of relevant testimonials should reach the Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Bathinda, Judicial Court Complex, Bathinda.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee details have been specified in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the detailed employment notice for any specific instructions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the notification and application form from the official website of the court at https://bathinda.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type and duration for these vacancies?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contract basis under the administrative setup of the Bathinda District Court, subject to terms and conditions outlined in the official notification.
